cards.title: Hidden Power
cards.instruction: Act publicly modest while making choices as though you control the outcome.

cards.title: Choose Me
cards.instruction: Make yourself the choice over another person, plan, or obligation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No need to put me in charge. Come to my birthday instead of the concert. I've made your favourite cake.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm merely helping this reach the right outcome. Bring your concert friend too. I'll reimburse both tickets in cake.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She only went because I promised her dancing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll clear the living room. You can choose the music; I'd just like to be in the room with you.

confusable: Not passive longing: A makes the substitute evening happen and chooses practical terms that absorb B other commitment.
comparison: Personal birthday competing with concert versus professional selection against another photographer.
